usageNotes: Rolls back a remote QEMU VM to a named snapshot, reverting its disk, config, and RAM state (if RAM was captured in the snapshot); the guest must be shut down before calling this unless the snapshot includes RAM state. Returns a remote UPID string representing the async task — poll the task status endpoint to confirm completion before treating the rollback as done. Requires Resource.Manage privilege on the remote/VM resource.

examples.summary: Roll back VM 105 on remote 'pve-hetzner' to snapshot 'pre-update' and start the guest after

destructiveReason: All disk and configuration changes made after the snapshot was taken are permanently discarded; if the snapshot does not include RAM state, any in-memory data at snapshot time is also lost.
tips: Take a fresh snapshot of the current state before rolling back if there is any chance you need to recover post-snapshot changes.
If 'node' is omitted, PDM selects an appropriate node automatically; specify it explicitly when the VM is on a specific cluster node to avoid ambiguity.
The returned UPID is scoped to the remote cluster — use the corresponding PDM task-status endpoint (not a local PVE node endpoint) to track it.
Snapshots with RAM state allow rollback while the VM is running, but this is rare and risky; prefer rolling back with the VM stopped.
